bio.text: Norm Needleman won election in November 2018 to represent the 33rd State Senate District, which covers twelve towns.

He has also been First Selectman of Essex since 2011, and earlier served on the Essex Board of Selectmen from 2003, the Zoning Board of Appeals from 1997 to 2003 and the Economic Development Commission from 1995 to 2003.
According to the Senate Democrats' biography, he founded a pharmaceutical manufacturing company about 40 years ago.
